description.en: The channel group description. It can be up to 1,000 characters in length.

description.zh: 频道组名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
description.en: The channel group name. It can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: \[A-Za-z0-9\_-]+

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明

通过此API，您可以修改实时打包服务中已创建的频道组的名称和描述信息。频道组名称须符合指定的字符规则，且描述长度不超过1000个字符。API响应将返回更新后的频道组详情及操作请求的唯一标识(RequestId)。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

This API operation allows you to modify the name and description of a live package channel group. The channel group name must conform to the naming conventions and can be up to 1,000 characters. The API response includes the updated channel group details and unique identifier of the request.
